Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating contracting standards of home care agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to home care agencies; and adding a new section tochapter 74.39A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall not contract with any home care agency, asdefined in RCW 70.127.010, that has been found by the department oflabor and industries or a court of competent jurisdiction to haveviolated any provision of chapters 39.12, 49.46, and 49.48 RCW, unlessthe department finds that denying a contract would seriously inhibitthe state's ability to provide vulnerable and elderly residents withquality communitybased home care or the agency's violation orviolations involved: (1) Very few employees; (2) a de minimus amountof wages per affected employee; or (3) an incidental offense.
